name: Ōyamazaki (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Ōyamazaki town emblem in white: an outlined trefoil of three petals enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Ōyamazaki, a town in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 October 1967.

features.role: Ōyamazaki town emblem — an outlined trefoil of three petals enclosing a stylised mountain
